Our work sits at the heart of innovation, helping customers push boundaries in performance, sustainability and design.
   

  

 We offer the chance to be part of a collaborative, forward‑thinking organisation where your ideas are valued, your development is supported, and your contribution has real impact on a global scale.
   

  

**About the Role\~**
 This is a key role responsible for coordinating demand, supply, inventory and production planning across our internal and external supply chain.
   

  

 You will translate sales forecasts and customer requirements into clear, achievable supply plans, working closely with production, procurement, logistics and commercial teams. You will help improve planning discipline, provide greater visibility of risks and support the business in meeting its customer service, revenue and inventory objectives.
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced planning professional who enjoys bringing structure to a growing business, working across multiple functions and using data to support effective decisions.
   

  

**Role Responsibilities\~**
* Supporting the development and delivery of demand, supply and inventory planning processes for the T\-FIT business.
* Coordinating regular demand and supply reviews, ensuring assumptions, constraints, risks and actions are clearly captured.
* Translating sales forecasts and customer requirements into practical supply and production plans.
* Working closely with production sites, procurement, logistics and commercial teams to align supply with demand.
* Maintaining accurate planning data, assumptions and key system inputs.
* Monitoring inventory and product availability, identifying risks relating to customer service, excess stock and working capital.
* Identifying capacity constraints, material risks and planning gaps that could affect monthly supply or revenue.
* Producing clear planning reports and updates covering demand, supply, inventory, service and forecast accuracy.
* Improving data quality, planning discipline and adherence to agreed processes.
* Escalating risks and trade\-offs clearly, supported by practical recommendations.
* Contributing to the continuous improvement of planning processes, reporting and ways of working.


**What you'll need\~**
* At least five years’ experience within supply chain planning, demand planning, production planning, manufacturing, logistics or a related role.
* A good understanding of demand, supply, inventory or production planning principles.
* Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data, spreadsheets, enterprise resource planning systems and planning reports.
* The ability to turn commercial forecasts and customer requirements into realistic operational plans.
* Clear communication skills and the confidence to work with stakeholders across commercial, manufacturing, procurement and logistics teams.
* Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage changing priorities.
* The confidence to challenge assumptions constructively, identify risks and recommend appropriate action.
* This role involves regular communication with stakeholders across the UK, Europe, USA and Asia, therefore strong spoken and written English is essential.


**It would be beneficial if you also have**
* A degree or professional qualification in supply chain, business, engineering or a related subject.
* Experience with sales and operations planning, sales and operations execution, material requirements planning or enterprise resource planning processes.
* Experience working within an international or multi\-site manufacturing business.


**Why Join Us?**
 Zotefoams is growing fast, investing globally and winning in new markets. This is a chance to be part of a business where things are moving, decisions are made quickly, and your work has real impact.
   

  

 You won’t be a small cog here. You’ll have the space to take ownership, contribute ideas and see them through. We back our people to develop, step up and build long term careers, supported by a team that works together and delivers.
   

  

**Our Values**
**Courage** 
 – We challenge, act and push for better.
   

  

**Impact** 
 – We focus on what matters and deliver results.
   

  

**Respect** 
 – We value different perspectives and work as one team.
   

  

 Zotefoams is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.
   

  

 Zotefoams is a world leader in cellular material technology. Using a unique manufacturing process with environmentally friendly nitrogen expansion, Zotefoams produces lightweight foams in Croydon, UK and Kentucky, USA for diverse markets worldwide. These markets include sports and leisure, storage and protection, automotive, aviation and space, railway, healthcare, building, marine and the military.

**Position Summary**
 The Revenue Manager is a Mid senior\-level finance professional responsible for the accurate recording, reporting, and management of revenue transactions and accounts receivable activities. This role requires deep expertise in US GAAP revenue recognition standards (ASC 606\), complex billing environments, and AR operations. The ideal candidate brings 12 years of progressive accounting experience with a significant portion dedicated to revenue accounting and accounts receivable management within a consumer goods, retail, or CPG organization.

 \- 3:00pm \- 12:00am (Extendable as per requirements as few hours collaboration is there with US teams)
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Revenue Accounting \& Recognition**
* Own end\-to\-end revenue accounting processes, ensuring transactions are recorded accurately and in compliance with ASC 606 and internal policies
* Analyze and review customer contracts, purchase orders, and trade agreements to determine appropriate revenue recognition treatment
* Complete semi\-annual transit time study for customers with FOB Destination shipping terms
* Prepare and post monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue journal entries including deferred revenue and accrued revenue
* Perform monthly revenue close activities, including reconciliation of revenue sub\-ledgers to the general ledger
* Manage complex revenue streams across multiple channels (e\-commerce and , wholesale,)
* Monitor and analyze gross\-to\-net revenue deductions, ensuring proper classification and timely recording
* Partner with Sales, Commercial Finance, and Legal teams to assess revenue implications of new contracts, promotions, and business arrangements
* Manage customer pricing in SAP including customer specific, allowances and discounts.


**Accounts Receivable Management**
* Oversee the full AR cycle including invoice generation, cash application, customer account reconciliation, and collections follow\-up
* Manage and maintain the AR sub\-ledger, ensuring timely and accurate posting of customer payments, credit memos, and adjustments
* Review and approve credit memos, write\-offs, and bad debt provisions in accordance with company policy
* Monitor days sales outstanding (DSO) and implement strategies to improve cash collection performance
* Coordinate with external auditors and provide supporting documentation for AR\-related audit requests
* Ensure compliance with SOX controls related to revenue and receivables processes


**Financial Reporting \& Analysis**
* Prepare monthly revenue and AR analytical reports for senior management and FP\&A teams
* Assist in the preparation of footnote disclosures related to revenue and receivables for quarterly and annual financial statements
* Perform variance analysis of actual revenue versus budget/forecast; communicate findings with clear narratives
* Develop and maintain revenue reporting dashboards and KPI trackers
* Support internal and external audit requests related to revenue recognition and AR


**Process Improvement \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Identify opportunities to streamline and automate revenue accounting and AR workflows; lead or support implementation of improvements
* Collaborate with IT/ERP teams on system enhancements, integrations, and UAT testing related to billing, AR, and revenue modules
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior accounting staff on revenue and AR processes
* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) on revenue recognition policy and AR best practices within the organization
* Support month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end close processes, meeting all reporting deadlines


**Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required. CPA designation strongly preferred
* Experience: Minimum 12 years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 6\-8 years in revenue accounting and/or accounts receivable roles
* Technical Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of ASC 606 (Revenue from Contracts with Customers) and US GAAP
* AR Expertise: Demonstrated experience managing the complete AR lifecycle including billing, cash application, collections, and reconciliation
* ERP Systems: Proficiency in large\-scale ERP systems (SAP, , NetSuite, or similar); experience with AR/Revenue modules required
* Excel Skills: Advanced Excel skills including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data modeling, and financial analysis
* SOX Compliance: Experience working within a SOX\-compliant environment with strong understanding of internal controls over financial reporting
* Analytical Skills: Excellent ability to analyze large datasets, identify trends, and communicate financial results to non\-finance stakeholders
* Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments
* Attention to Detail: High degree of accuracy and meticulous attention to detail in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment


**Preferred Qualifications**
* CPA license or CMA certification
* Experience in the consumer packaged goods (CPG), beauty, retail, or e\-commerce industry
* Exposure to trade promotion management (TPM) and chargeback processing
* Experience with BI/reporting tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker
* Prior experience with revenue accounting in a multi\-channel or omnichannel retail environment
* Familiarity with ASC 740 (income taxes) or intercompany accounting a plus
* Experience supporting IPO readiness or working in a publicly traded company


**Competencies \& Attributes**
* Integrity: Upholds the highest standards of accuracy, transparency, and ethical conduct
* Ownership: Takes accountability for deliverables; proactively identifies and resolves issues
* Collaboration: Works cross\-functionally with operations, commercial, legal, and IT teams and other counter parts across US and UK
* Adaptability: Thrives in a high\-growth, dynamic environment with evolving processes and priorities
* Leadership: Mentors and develops team members; contributes to a culture of continuous improvement

 www.sambhaavtrust.in
 



  





**Roles and Responsibilities:** 





 As the Finance and Administration Manager, you will oversee the following:
 



1. **Daily Accounting:** 

 Entry and verification of vouchers into Tally or suitable accounting software on a daily basis.
2. **Data Management:** 

 Entry and verification of financial and activity data from bills/vouchers into spreadsheets for planning, monitoring, and review on a daily basis.
3. **Payment Processing:** 

 Processing of payments to team members, vendors, partners, etc., after authorization, on a weekly basis.
4. **Statutory \& Internal Reporting:** 

 Preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual reports for audit, Income Tax, FCRA, Charity Commissioner, and other statutory returns, as well as for internal monitoring and evaluation.
5. **Travel Oversight:** 

 Review and monitoring of travel log sheets submitted by team members on a monthly basis.
6. **Event Logistics:** 

 Support in administrative tasks such as organizing logistics for team events, board meetings, and other organizational events.
7. **Field Monitoring:** 

 Regular visits to field offices for reviewing financial and administrative arrangements on the ground, as well as monitoring the condition of organizational assets.
8. **Office \& Asset Management:** 

 Repair and maintenance of the Ahmedabad office and assets, including finding tenants for the office and preparing rent/lease agreements.
9. **Team \& Stakeholder Coordination:** 

 Managing the overall work of the Finance and Administration team at Ahmedabad; coordinating with CAs, lawyers, tax consultants, and other vendors; coordinating with donors and regulators regarding financial transactions; and collaborating with on\-ground program teams in Rajasthan and across India.
10. **Policy Development:** 

 Preparation and updation of Finance, Procurement, HR, Travel, and other related organizational policies.
11. **General Admin:** 

 Any other Finance and Administration tasks as needed.

* **Experience:** 

 5\+ years of proven experience in financial accounting, management and organisation administration (Required)

 Professional fluency in English (Required)

 Starting from ₹35,000\.00 per month

 Cell phone reimbursement and commuter assistance

description:

* Lead the annual budgeting process and periodic forecasting exercises for the Africa region.

* Strengthen payment controls and ensure appropriate documentation and approvals.

* Review inventory levels and monitor inventory liquidation plans to optimize stock holdings.
* Drive initiatives to minimize slow\-moving and limited shelf\-life (LSL) inventory.
* Review customer receivables and ensure timely collection of outstanding balances.
* Monitor debtor ageing and collaborate with business teams to improve collections.
* Prepare and review cash flow forecasts and liquidity plans.
* Manage working capital effectively to optimize cash generation and financial performance.

* Ensure compliance with all statutory, tax, regulatory, and internal corporate requirements.
* Coordinate and manage internal and external audits across the region.

* Financial Reporting \& MIS
